<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>
#include <deque>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <random>

using namespace std;

const int INF = 1e6;

class C {
public:
    ifstream fin;
    ofstream fout;
    string line;
    stringstream ss;
    bool eof;

    void submit() {
        int n = nextInt();
        string s = nextToken();
        fout << fast(s) << endl;
    }

    string prepare(string s) {
        string sb;
        for (char c : s) {
            if (BAD.find(c) != string::npos) {
                sb += c;
            } else {
                sb += 'A';
            }
        }
        return sb;
    }

    int slow(string s) {
        s = prepare(s);
        unordered_map<string, int> map;
        deque<string> que;
        que.push_back(s);
        map[s] = 0;

        while (true) {
            s = que.front();
            que.pop_front();
            int curD = map[s];
            if (s.find(BAD) == string::npos) {
                return curD;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < s.length() - 1; i++) {
                string nxt = swap(s, i, i + 1);
                if (nxt != "" && map.find(nxt) == map.end()) {
                    map[nxt] = curD + 1;
                    que.push_back(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    string swap(string s, int i, int j) {
        if (s[i] == s[j]) {
            return "";
        }
        char tmp = s[i];
        s[i] = s[j];
        s[j] = tmp;
        return s;
    }

    int fast(string s) {
        s = prepare(s);

        int n = s.length();

        vector<int> a(n);
        vector<int> pos[3];
        int sz[3] = {0};
        vector<vector<int>> cntHere(3, vector<int>(n, 0));

        vector<vector<int>> pref(n + 1);
        pref[0] = vector<int>(3, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = STR.find(s[i]);
            int c = a[i];
            cntHere[c][sz[c]] = pref[i];
            pos[c].push_back(i);
            sz[c]++;

            pref[i + 1] = pref[i];
            pref[i + 1][c]++;
        }

        vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp(2, vector<vector<vector<int>>>(sz[0] + 1, vector<vector<int>>(sz[1] + 1, vector<int>(sz[2] + 1, INF))));

        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= sz[0]; j0++) {
                for (int j1 = 0; j1 <= sz[1]; j1++) {
                    for (int j2 = 0; j2 <= sz[2]; j2++) {
                        fill(dp[i][j0][j1].begin(), dp[i][j0][j1].end(), INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int ans = INF;

        dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;
        for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= sz[0]; j0++) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 <= sz[1]; j1++) {
                for (int j2 = 0; j2 <= sz[2]; j2++) {
                    for (int last = 0; last < 2; last++) {
                        int idx = j0 + j1 + j2;
                        int curVal = dp[last][j0][j1][j2];
                        if (curVal == INF) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        if (idx == n) {
                            ans = min(ans, curVal);
                            continue;
                        }

                        if (j0 < sz[0]) {
                            int cost = max(j1 - cntHere[0][j0][1], 0) + max(j2 - cntHere[0][j0][2], 0);
                            dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2] = min(dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2], curVal + cost);
                        }

                        if (j1 < sz[1] && last == 0) {
                            int cost = max(j0 - cntHere[1][j1][0], 0) + max(j2 - cntHere[1][j1][2], 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2] = min(dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2], curVal + cost);
                        }

                        if (j2 < sz[2]) {
                            int cost = max(j0 - cntHere[2][j2][0], 0) + max(j1 - cntHere[2][j2][1], 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1] = min(dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1], curVal + cost);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return ans;
    }

    string genStr() {
        random_device rd;
        mt19937 gen(rd());
        uniform_int_distribution<> dis(0, 2);
        string s;
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            s += STR[dis(gen)];
        }
        return s;
    }

    void stress() {
        random_device rd;
        mt19937 gen(rd());
        uniform_int_distribution<> dis(0, 2);
        while (true) {
            string s = genStr();
            int fast = fast(s);
            int slow = slow(s);
            if (fast != slow) {
                cout << s << endl;
                cout << fast << endl;
                cout << slow << endl;
                throw runtime_error("Assertion failed");
            }
            cout << "Test case passed" << endl;
        }
    }

    C() {
        fin.open("input.txt");
        fout.open("output.txt");
        submit();
        fout.close();
    }

    string nextToken() {
        while (ss.str().empty() && !fin.eof()) {
            getline(fin, line);
            ss.clear();
            ss.str(line);
        }
        if (ss.str().empty()) {
            eof = true;
            return "";
        }
        string token;
        ss >> token;
        return token;
    }

    string nextString() {
        string token;
        getline(fin, token);
        return token;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(nextToken());
    }

    long nextLong() {
        return stoll(nextToken());
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(nextToken());
    }
};

int main() {
    C c;
    return 0;
}
